about: What the engine shows and hides that the layout files do not say: gadgets it keeps hidden until a moment of the game (patterns of gadget names, any case, * for any text), and gadgets of which it shows one. Read from the copy's own files and the stock exe's behaviour as seen in game; each is to verify, and the screen lets every moment be switched on.
